title: MultiComboBox
description: Fiori multi combo box: tokens plus a filterable check box list, "show selected" via n more, select all and the SAP keyboard model.

usage.summary: Select several predefined options from a filterable list and display selections as tokens.
useWhen: Choose multiple supplied MultiComboBoxItem values while typing narrows the list.
Control selectedValues and onSelectionChange separately from the typed value.
Offer showSelectAll when selecting the whole option set is useful; keep the default validation when entries must match supplied items.

avoidWhen.when: Create arbitrary or application-validated tokens; noValidation permits unmatched text but does not turn it into a selected option.
Search a large business dataset by several attributes or define ranges and conditions.
